---
name: Fitment & Tolerance Feedback
about: Report tight clearances, loose connectors, or slide-door friction
title: "[FIT]"
labels: help wanted
assignees: camiu01

---

**Component or Joint Involved**
Which part is affected? (e.g., XT60 cutout, Banana post spacing, Z-dovetail side door slide, M3 heat-set insert cavity).

**Observed Fit Issue**
- [ ] Too tight / cannot insert without force or post-processing
- [ ] Too loose / excessive play or rattles
- [ ] Layer binding / dovetail friction prevents door sliding
- [ ] Screw anchor alignment mismatch

**Print Details**
- **Filament Type:** (e.g., PETG, PLA, ABS)
- **Printer / Slicer:** (e.g., Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer)
- **Nozzle & Layer Height:** (e.g., 0.4mm nozzle, 0.20mm standard)
- **Fuzzy Skin:** [ ] Yes (Contour only) / [ ] No
- **`print_tolerance` value used in OpenSCAD:** (Default is usually ~0.3mm)

**Suggested Adjustment**
How much offset would fix it? (e.g., "+0.2 mm to the cutout width" or "increase dovetail clearance").
